item: Item #8 (v73.2.4 Gate 3: Cloudflare D1 11-User-Table Rust/Gatekeeper Cleanup & Permanent account_id Non-Migration Decision)
reason_for_partial: D1 database, Hyperdrive config, and KV namespace were rotated to fresh instances and old exposed instances were permanently deleted (verified live via wrangler); Cloudflare tenant account_id is immutable in-place without migrating to a separate Cloudflare tenant account, and Donevin Frownfelter permanently decided NOT to migrate to a new account.

account_id.note: Cloudflare tenant account_id is a platform-immutable 32-char path identifier (Update Account API only renames); Donevin Frownfelter permanently decided NOT to migrate zone, tunnel, and VPC mesh to a new Cloudflare account, and account_id is NOT rotated.

compensating_controls.api_auth_isolation: Cloudflare OAuth / scoped API tokens stored exclusively outside git; Deploy-CloudflareEdge.ps1 and Verify-CloudflareRotationLive.ps1 strip CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and render ephemeral configs in $env:TEMP.
compensating_controls.edge_auth_layers: Cloudflare Access RS256 JWT + encrypted SOVEREIGN_OPERATOR_KEY secret (X-Sovereign-Operator-Key header, ?key= rejected) + pre-proxy 403 gate in worker_vpc_shadow_v3700.js.
gate2_v73_2_4_controls: Item #2: /api/v1/l0_core/execute_41_modules, /api/v1/l0_core/sheaf_engine, /api/v1/tools/t275..t280, and /api/v1/tool/275..280 gated pre-lock via enforce_operator_gate_403 at L0 and pre-proxy at Cloudflare Edge (parsedToolNum 1..=404).

Item #3: Full chain135_json (including t341 and /api/v1/tool/308..315), SSE /api/v1/sovereign_harmonic/converse, mutating /api/v1/unified/*, and 7 legacy /api/v1/{stiefel,acoustic,wgsl,compute,debate,hotpatch,codegen} routes gated pre-lock at L0; isEdgeGatedBeforeOrigin expanded in worker_vpc_shadow_v3700.js; App.tsx attaches X-Sovereign-Operator-Key via getOperatorHeaders().

Item #4: /api/v1/worksteal/webgpu_lease, /api/v1/tools/t78, and /api/v1/tool/78 gated at L0 + Edge; self-computing CRC fallback and kops 420.0/NaN collapse deleted in v44; poc_hash independently verified over real 2,080-cacheline .e8z 6D Plucker FNV-1a and kops bounded 50.0..=850.0 (400 Bad Request fail-closed).

Item #5: All 9 remaining extract_query_param(raw_target, "key") checks replaced with 4-pass percent-decoding v73_2_has_query_key_param returning 403 on ?key=, ?%6bey=, and ?%4Bey= even with valid operator header.

Item #6: Test-SovereignKeyLeakScan refactored to git ls-files -z + in-memory .NET SovereignByteStreamScanner (zero secret CLI args) and -TestNegativeTelemetryKeyInjection refactored to ephemeral in-memory synthetic keys (zero %TEMP% live keys).
gate3_v73_2_4_controls: Item #8 L0 D1 11-User-Table Sync: v73_2_read_live_d1_user_tables() and v73_2_read_live_d1_database_name() parse sqlite_master results live from s6_cloudflare_live_wrangler_verification.txt (act_omega_d1_vault_v7322, 11 user tables, fail-closed UNMEASURED/OFFLINE / null), eliminating all active L0 Rust "10 Tables", "10-Table", "10 TABLES", "tables_count":10, v44_operationalized_research_shards, v44_multiturn_discourse_memory, and stale act_omega_d1_vault literals.

Item #8 Strict MCP resources/read URI & Edge Tables Count: v61_read_resource_metadata() in L0 Rust and resources/read in worker_vpc_shadow_v3700.js require exact live URI match (manifold://d1/act_omega_d1_vault_v7322), return NOT_FOUND on retired manifold://d1/act_omega_d1_vault or arbitrary D1 URIs, and include live sqlite_master tables_count (11) on Edge resources/read.

Item #8 Gatekeeper Expansion: Invoke-BrutalAgentGatekeeper.ps1 expanded across all 01_l0_rust/src/**/*.rs (// comment-stripped) with upgraded $staleD1TablePattern including (?<!\w)act_omega_d1_vault(?!_v7322(?!\w)) and 7/7 negative/control tests in tests/e2e/test_m3_gatekeeper_negative.ps1.

Item #7 Live APK Manifest: v73_2_extract_apk_version_code() extracts android:versionCode (0x0101021B) directly from shipped APK ZIP+DEFLATE+AXML bytes in /api/v1/ota/pixel_manifest and /api/v1/tools/t284 (fail-closed null / UNMEASURED/OFFLINE).
compensating_controls.residual_risk: Historical account_id values remain in prior git commits (e9804bf2 and earlier); account_id cannot rotate in-place without migrating zone, tunnel, and VPC mesh to a new Cloudflare account.

wrangler_parameterization.root_deploy_note: Direct wrangler deploy from repo root is restricted because root wrangler.toml holds <EXTERNAL_*> tokens and must be rendered via Deploy-CloudflareEdge.ps1 -ConfigScope root.

gatekeeper_repo_wide_scan.scope: git ls-files (all tracked repository files + wrangler*.toml literal hex check)
